title: Synthesis of Novel Dinaphthosulfide,Aza, Oxa, Thia Lariats ContainingUrea and Thiourea Groups in the Side Chain and Their Nanostructures
abstract: Dinaphhosulfide aza, oxa, thia crown was prepared; its urea and thiourea derivatives were synthesized by the reaction with ethyl and 4‐chlorophenyl isocyanate, ethyl and phenylisothiocyanate. Self‐assembled structures are as micro and nano fibers and discs.
